event: US retail sales today, Tue 17 Nov, at 15:30 SAST (time UNVERIFIED), then Nvidia earnings after the US close. FOMC minutes Wed 18 Nov at 21:00 SAST.

bullets.title: Overnight bounce
bullets.text: Spot gold was 3,870.60 at 06:48 SAST, up 15.10 (0.39%) on the day, after Monday's 3,832.20 low (Kitco).

bullets.title: Prices disagree
bullets.text: Trading Economics shows 3,883.15 and FXEmpire 3,874.48 for 17 Nov, so the exact price is UNVERIFIED within about 3,870-3,883.

bullets.title: Still near lows
bullets.text: Gold is near a 14-month low and down about 4.7% this week and 7.5% this month (Trading Economics, FXEmpire).

bullets.title: Hike nearly priced
bullets.text: Markets price over 95% odds of a December quarter-point hike, with the rest on a half-point (Trading Economics).

bullets.title: Dollar and yields
bullets.text: The dollar index is 103.49, slightly lower, and US yields are near 5.13% (Trading Economics).

bullets.title: Hawkish Fed talk
bullets.text: Hot October inflation and hawkish comments from Cleveland Fed's Hammack are weighing on gold (Trading Economics).

bullets.title: Busy calendar
bullets.text: Retail sales today and FOMC minutes on Wednesday can move gold fast.
